text:
sami.berg: Heads-up \u2014 soft launch of a mixed-edge A800x pool in Porto (pt-1) starting now. This is a small, partner-first pilot for low-latency Iberia traffic. :shipit:

francesca.li: Nice. What does soft launch mean for reservations and SLAs?

sami.berg: Soft launch = limited capacity, no formal SLA, 10-day reservation window available for partners. We'll prioritize reservations over ad-hoc requests. Billing uses existing dedicated SKUs.

deploy-bot: [automated] pool-create: dedicated-a800x-pt-1-edge-01 created (6x A800x) by infra-deploy. Telemetry: enabled.

infra-ops: Ops note: this region will share an isolation plane with nearby Lisbon pools; fallback routing to li-1 will be enabled for availability but will incur higher latency. Preemption policy: reserved workloads protected during reservation window; unreserved are soft-preemptible under pressure.

francesca.li: Sales Q: can we offer any latency SLA for partners?

sami.berg: For partners in preview, state "best-effort; reserve for production stability." We'll publish p50/p95 after 48h telemetry. No SLA until GA.

ops-runbook: Quick runbook snippet:
```
# reserve a preview slot
rcli reserve --region pt-1 --gpu A800x --count 1 --days 10
# check pool status
rcli pool status --name dedicated-a800x-pt-1-edge-01
# request fallback to li-1 (support only)
/rdev ticket create --tag dedicated-a800x-pt-1 --summary "request fallback routing"
```

infra-ops: Note: autoscaling disabled during soft launch. We will enable controlled burst and mixed-gpu scheduling after 72h if telemetry stable. Also deploying heatmap alerts now.

deploy-bot: [automated] alert rule added: a800x-pt-1-thermal (warn 80%, critical 94%).

sales-emea: We'll mark offers as "partner preview" and route signups through solutions engineering. No GA commitments in customer-facing collateral.

francesca.li: Any expected delta in unit economics vs larger pools?

sami.berg: Billable rate is same; effective cost-per-token may be higher until we scale. Recommend customers use reservations to reduce variance.

infra-ops: Follow-up: we'll post a 48h utilization + p50/p95 snapshot in this thread and decide on enabling burst/fallback as a GA behavior. Ping infra-ops for escalations. :white_check_mark:
